name: CSO_STG_REQ_ACT_CAPT_SRCH
description: Temporary table needed for ETL. Will contain only an hours worth of data of svc_req_action_capture table.

columns.name: REQUEST_AC_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SESSION_ID
columns.description: ID to track the contiguous usage of REST API from CSS for a given user session.

columns.name: SESSION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Stores the SESSION_TYPE_ID of the matching URI_PATTERN.

columns.name: SESSION_USER
columns.description: Actual logged in user or the integration appid when anonymous session in the CSS.

columns.name: REQUEST_DATE
columns.description: Systime when the request came in.

columns.name: REQUEST_URI
columns.description: Full URI of the incoming request including the parameters.

columns.name: ACTION_TYPE
columns.description: To capture the HTTP VERB for the resource.

columns.name: PROXY_USER_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate whether the value in the user column is end user or proxy user.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FAMILY
columns.description: To identify the product FA product family - default to CRM.

columns.name: REQUEST_URL
columns.description: Full URL of the incoming request including the parameters.

columns.name: REQUEST_HEADER
columns.description: Header details of the incoming request.

columns.name: REQUEST_PAYLOAD
columns.description: Payload details of the incoming request.

columns.name: RESPONSE_CODE
columns.description: Response status code of the incoming request.

columns.name: RESPONSE_PAYLOAD
columns.description: Payload details of the search request.
